response.original_title: What if It’s not Meant for Me
response.overview: Dia struggles to accept the relationships around her while slowly realizing that she cannot truly accept others until she learns to accept herself. Through friendship, love, and self-discovery, the film offers an authentic portrayal of the protagonist’s high school friendships and the emotions that come with growing up and finding your place among the people you love.  Winner of 1st Place at the International EthnoKino Festival.
response.tagline: “We don’t see things as they are, but as we are.”
response.title: What if It’s not Meant for Me
